conflicts.detail: Manufacturer DE page lists 31 items incl. Dimethiconol (#10), Dimethicone (#14), TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate, Tetrasodium EDTA, Trideceth-10, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Benzyl Alcohol, Triethylene Glycol, Propylene Glycol and no fragrance sub-components (Hexamethylindanopyran, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes) and no Avena Sativa Kernel Extract. dm.de and Rossmann (both GTIN 8006530222037) list an identical 23-item silicone-free list with Hexamethylindanopyran, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes and Avena Sativa Kernel Extract. Lists not merged.

The manufacturer page itself claims '0% Farbstoffe und Silikone' (alt text; pack front shows a 0% silicone badge) and dm says 'Produkteigenschaften: ohne Silikone', yet the manufacturer INCI contains Dimethiconol and Dimethicone. The retailer list is consistent with the silicone-free claim; the manufacturer list is not. The manufacturer's own disclaimer: 'Bitte beachten Sie die Produktverpackung für die aktuellste Liste der Inhaltstoffe.'
'Aloe Vera' claim: Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice present in all lists. 'Pirocton-Olamin': Piroctone Olamine present.

canonicalReason: Two independent GTIN-anchored German retailers (dm, Rossmann; GTIN 8006530222037) agree verbatim, and their silicone-free list is the only one consistent with the manufacturer's own '0% Silikone' pack/page claim. The manufacturer page list (31 items, with dimethicone/dimethiconol) contradicts that claim and defers to the pack. Pack back not read, so the manufacturer exact pack could not be used to arbitrate. Canonical chosen under the >=2 independent GTIN-anchored sources rule; flagged frozen_with_conflict because the manufacturer list is materially different (silicones, niacinamide, panthenol).
normalization: Canonical list = the ordered INCI items, each lower-cased, trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed; items joined with '|' and sha256 over the UTF-8 string. Split synonym entries (e.g. 'Aqua (Water, Eau)') are merged into one item before hashing; trailing full stops removed.
notes: NEEDS NICK / pack check: the earlier v1.3/v1.4 freeze used the manufacturer 31-item list as its 'official' source (formula-source.json, fingerprint 048df67c...), so any prior classification (e.g. conditioning/weight from dimethicone) was built on the other list. Recommend one look at a physical 250 ml bottle back panel to settle which list is current.
